facts.claim: Employees and managers interact through Microsoft Teams and Azure Bot Service with Adaptive Cards.
Azure App Service runs Python 3.11 with FastAPI, LangGraph state machine, and internal MCP server.
Azure Functions consume Service Bus messages to trigger asynchronous SLA reminders and 72-hour HR escalations.
Azure AI Foundry provides gpt-4o for conversational reasoning and text-embedding-3-small for policy embeddings.
Azure AI Search provides hybrid BM25 and vector search with section-level citations over approved HR policies.
Azure Storage Account holds approved HR policy documents for indexing.
Azure Cosmos DB stores tickets in hr-ticket-store and conversation memory in hr-conversation-memory.
Azure Service Bus hr-sla-jobs queue holds scheduled reminder and escalation messages with duplicate detection.
Key Vault and Entra ID Managed Identities enforce zero hardcoded secrets and RBAC.
Application Insights and Log Analytics collect PII-redacted audit events and operational metrics.
Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, and Enterprise HRIS provide identity, reporting hierarchy, and balance verification.
All Azure resources are contained in a customer-owned Managed Resource Group with Deny Assignment.
Publisher support operators access the MRG via customer-approved, time-bound Just-In-Time elevation.
Official Microsoft Azure and product icons are verified and rendered from the verified icon catalog.

exclusions: Payroll execution and automated banking transfers are out of scope.
